aquarium-salt.name: API Aquarium Salt
aquarium-salt.note: Often used alongside medication for ich.

quarantine-net-breeder.name: Lee's Net Breeder
quarantine-net-breeder.note: Useful for isolating a sick fish during treatment.

water-test-kit.note: Tests ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, and pH — the first step for almost every water-quality issue.

beneficial-bacteria-starter.note: Speeds up establishing the bacteria colony a new tank needs.
